idea-plugin.name: Live JVM Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Live CPU, heap and thread charts for the Java application you start from a run configuration. Works in IntelliJ IDEA without an Ultimate subscription.

  • A JVM Monitor tab opens at the bottom as soon as the plugin connects to the application JVM.
  • CPU load of the process, used and committed heap, live thread count, sampled once per second.
  • The last two minutes of history, with labeled scales.
  • Finds the application JVM forked by Maven, not only the process started by the IDE.

The plugin connects through the standard Attach API and reads platform MXBeans. No agent and no changes to your run configuration are needed.

Tested on macOS and Windows. The Gradle bootRun task is not supported yet: its JVM runs inside the Gradle daemon.
